questions.text: The decision has no recorded rationale. Which Firebase Auth sign-in methods should be supported for hospital staff and patients (e.g. email/password, phone OTP, Google sign-in)?

The blueprint already assigns session/JWT issuance and RBAC to the Identity Service microservice. Does adopting Firebase mean Firebase Auth fully replaces the Identity Service session/JWT layer (client authenticates directly against Firebase, backend just verifies Firebase ID tokens), or does the Identity Service keep minting its own JWTs/sessions after Firebase only verifies credentials?

Does this Firebase decision apply to both hospital staff and patient sign-in, or only one of these user types? (Blueprint notes patients are registered by staff first and may not have login credentials of their own initially.)
